name: DEAD DETENTION
source:
Dead Detention is an anime-inspired scribble-y, roughly (some would say 'badly') drawn interactive story 'game' about an otaku turned dooms day survivor!

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/649253]newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
《Dead Detention》是一款受动漫启发的涂鸦式、粗略（有些人会说“糟糕”）绘制的互动故事“游戏”，讲述了一个宅男变身的世界末日幸存者！

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/649253]newgrounds[/url]]
